facts.label: Planos do fim de semana
facts.sub: Pergunte What are you going to do today? Responda I am going to go to the market. Pergunte Do you have plans for Sunday? e combine Let’s meet at ten.

facts.label: Tarefas do sábado
facts.sub: Muitos americanos usam o sábado para o mercado, o banco e a lavanderia. As lojas ficam cheias pela manhã, e quem vai cedo evita fila.

facts.label: O correio
facts.sub: O correio abre no sábado só de manhã e costuma fechar no domingo. Para enviar uma carta, você precisa de selo ou do atendente.

pages.title: A busy Saturday · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in Seattle. The sun is out and the street is full of people. Lia carries a bag with her dirty clothes. She sees her neighbor Ben near the bus stop. He has a long list in his hand. They say hello and start to talk.
“Hi, Lia! Happy Saturday!” says Ben. “Hi, Ben! What are you going to do today?” says Lia. “I am going to go to the market and the post office.” says Ben.
